status: read-only subject-focus audit of all 60 registered Property Declarations

baseline_layers.application: These are shared default layers only. Property Declarations must not duplicate them; a matching common/local signature may narrow the default only for its own endpoints, direction, and source-side degree.

audit_summary.scope_rule: A Property Claim may read same-bearer context, selected populations for tuples, or declared derived inputs, but must not require, write, or cardinally constrain another active Property/Node as its own conclusion.

foreign_actual_constraint.subject: Atom/(.Role := Plan).Work Sequence Number
foreign_actual_constraint.clause: IF Active Plan has Work Sequence Number THEN Relations.contained_by{==1}
foreign_actual_constraint.why_foreign: The active subject is Work Sequence Number, but the conclusion requires occurrence of the separate Relations.contained_by Property.
foreign_actual_constraint.minimal_safe_candidate: Move only that IF/THEN to the Plan Primary Declaration or a Plan grouping Rule. Retain Work Sequence Number's own optional-int/positive contract and both UNIQUE tuple constraints here; their Status and contained_by reads are contextual tuple inputs, not foreign conclusions.
foreign_actual_constraint.counterexample: An Active Plan with a sequence number but no contained_by is rejected by a Work Sequence Number Claim even though the conclusion changes a different Property's required occurrence.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Atom.Updated At
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: Event Record filter and MAX determine the active Atom.Updated At value; the Claim does not require/write Event Record fields.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Projection.Updated At
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: Event Record fields are read-only aggregate inputs to the active Projection.Updated At value.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Atom.Content.Summary
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: DETERMINES constrains Summary for selected Atom instances; ID/Status are tuple selectors, not foreign required facts.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Projection.ID
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: Form and Source.Named Selection are tuple basis inputs to ID; neither is written or cardinally constrained.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Atom/(.Role := Plan).AI Agent Confidence Threshold
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: LOOKUP reads containment-chain and Project Settings fallback values without creating a source Property or changing source occurrences.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Atom.Tier.Label
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: Tier is read to constrain the active Label's allowed derived value; Tier itself is not changed.

safe_contextual_invariants.subject: Event Record.ID
safe_contextual_invariants.reason: UNIQUE compares the active ID Property across Event Record instances, without constraining another Property.

prose_and_schema_assessment.subject: Scope Unit.Path
prose_and_schema_assessment.finding: The containment-chain prose describes the active Path's value meaning; it does not constrain a foreign Scope Unit. Keep until a reusable ancestry-value operator exists.

prose_and_schema_assessment.subject: Atom.Tier
prose_and_schema_assessment.finding: Project Goal/owner wording constrains Tier values, not those external subjects. It is not a subject-focus defect, but formalization still needs admitted Goal/owner selectors.

prose_and_schema_assessment.subject: Atom/(.Role := Requirement)/(.Form := Relation Definition).Content.notation_for_subject
prose_and_schema_assessment.finding: Relation admission is contextual input to the active notation Property. No foreign occurrence is required; retain prose until ADMITTED_VALUES is admitted.

prose_and_schema_assessment.subject: Projection.Source.Atoms
prose_and_schema_assessment.finding: Atom ID/Version wording constrains each active Property value representation; it grants no edge and changes no Atom.

common_relation_reuse.no_local_duplicates: No Property Claim duplicates IS_PROPERTY_OF, NARROWER_THAN/HAS_NARROWER, INSTANCE_OF/HAS_INSTANCE, or the new wildcard defaults.
common_relation_reuse.property_bearing: IS_PROPERTY_OF remains common Property -> bearer topology; HAS_PROPERTY inverse degree belongs to bearer-side constraints.
common_relation_reuse.value_boundary: Colon allowed values and HAS_VALUE stay non-graph bindings. Typed reference formats do not grant graph Relations.

real_open_question.question: Does ALLOWED VALUE mean the existing non-graph colon/HAS_VALUE binding or a new graph Relation named ALLOWED_VALUE?
real_open_question.reason: Only the latter would need an exception to either wildcard layer and new endpoint/cardinality semantics.
